clientArea.newOperationDesc: Request a new import or export operation
clientArea.trackShipmentDesc: Track the status of your goods
clientArea.newsSubtitle: Stay up to date with the latest updates on customs clearance, ports and foreign trade
clientArea.newsTitle1: New container terminal at Port of Santos
clientArea.newsContent1: The Port of Santos inaugurated a new terminal that will increase container handling capacity by 30%, reducing waiting times and improving operational efficiency.
clientArea.newsContent2: The Federal Revenue published new guidelines that simplify the customs clearance process for low-value imports, speeding up the clearance of goods.
clientArea.newsTitle3: Port of Paranaguá records movement record
clientArea.newsContent3: The Port of Paranaguá broke a historical record for cargo movement in the last quarter, with emphasis on grain exports and imports of manufactured products.
clientArea.newsTitle4: Digital customs clearance system gains new features
clientArea.newsContent4: The digital customs clearance platform has been updated with new features that allow real-time tracking and automatic notifications about the status of operations.
clientArea.newsTitle5: Infrastructure improvements at Port of Itajaí
clientArea.newsContent5: The Port of Itajaí began modernization works that include yard expansion, new handling equipment and an automated cargo tracking system.
